text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After putting in an exceptional performance at the Oka Sho, Fine Motion returns to me in sky-high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her radiance is enough to inspire confidence in a certain Umamusume who was struggling before the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the second crown of the Triple Tiara tour—we're heading for the Japanese Oaks!
